serverlessApi.title: Serverless API Development
serverlessApi.description: A lightweight, scalable backend solution built on AWS. Get a REST API powered by API Gateway and Lambda, connected to a database that fits your application's needs.
features: REST API setup using Amazon API Gateway
Serverless backend development with AWS Lambda
Database integration: Amazon DynamoDB or Amazon RDS
Environment and configuration setup
Deployment to AWS
Basic API documentation

lightsail.title: AWS Lightsail Deployment
lightsail.description: Launch your MVP, business website, or small application with an affordable and easy-to-manage cloud infrastructure. AWS Lightsail provides predictable pricing and simplified server management, making it a great starting point for small businesses and growing projects.
features: AWS Lightsail instance configuration
Linux server setup and hardening
Application deployment and environment configuration
Domain and DNS configuration
SSL certificate setup
Basic monitoring and deployment documentation

workflowAutomation.title: Cloud Workflow Automation
workflowAutomation.description: Automate business processes and orchestrate complex tasks using AWS managed services. Build reliable workflows that combine serverless functions and containerized applications to streamline operations, integrate systems, and reduce manual work.
features: Workflow orchestration with AWS Step Functions
Serverless task execution using AWS Lambda
Containerized workloads with Amazon ECS
Integration with APIs and external services
Automated task scheduling and execution
Error handling, retries, and execution monitoring
Deployment and technical documentation

vmMigration.title: VM to AWS EC2 Migration & Audit
vmMigration.description: Move your existing virtual machines to AWS with a structured migration approach. Start with an infrastructure assessment to evaluate your current environment, identify dependencies, estimate AWS costs, and plan a reliable migration to Amazon EC2.
vmMigration.imageAlt: Virtual machine migration to AWS EC2 architecture
features: Existing VM infrastructure assessment
CPU, memory, storage, and network analysis
Application and system dependency review
AWS EC2 instance recommendations
Migration strategy and execution planning
AWS cost estimation and optimization opportunities
Post-migration validation and documentation

costAudit.title: AWS Cost Optimization & Audit
costAudit.description: Gain visibility into your AWS spending and discover opportunities to reduce unnecessary costs. Get a comprehensive review of your cloud infrastructure, resource utilization, and billing patterns, along with actionable recommendations to improve cost efficiency.
costAudit.imageAlt: AWS cloud cost management and optimization dashboard
features: AWS billing and cost breakdown analysis
Resource utilization and infrastructure assessment
Identification of idle and underutilized resources
EC2 instance sizing and optimization recommendations
Storage and data transfer cost analysis
AWS pricing model and purchasing options review
Cost optimization recommendations and audit report

governanceAudit.title: AWS Organizations & Landing Zone Audit
governanceAudit.description: Assess your AWS multi-account environment to improve security, governance, and access control. Review your AWS Organizations structure, Control Tower landing zone configuration, IAM permissions, and Service Control Policies to identify security gaps and establish consistent governance across your cloud infrastructure.
governanceAudit.imageAlt: AWS Organizations and Control Tower multi-account architecture
features: AWS Organizations structure and account management assessment
Organizational Units (OUs) hierarchy and account organization review
AWS Control Tower landing zone configuration audit
IAM users, roles, policies, and permission assessment
Service Control Policies (SCPs) review and recommendations
Cross-account access and permission boundary assessment
Security and governance best practices evaluation
Audit report with prioritized recommendations

securityAudit.title: AWS Security, Networking & WAF Audit
securityAudit.description: A technical audit of your AWS infrastructure focused on identifying security vulnerabilities, network misconfigurations, and gaps in application protection. Review VPC architecture, security groups, network ACLs, and AWS WAF rules to strengthen your infrastructure and reduce exposure to potential attacks.
securityAudit.imageAlt: AWS security, networking, and WAF architecture audit
features: VPC architecture and network segmentation review
Public and private subnet configuration
Route tables, Internet Gateways, and NAT Gateways
Security Groups and Network ACLs review
Load Balancer and network exposure assessment
AWS WAF Web ACL, rules, and managed rule groups review
Rate-based rules, IP restrictions, and application-layer protection
Identification of overly permissive access and potential security gaps
Prioritized recommendations and audit report
